title: Improved quote form submission and error reporting
summary: Added the selected service type to the CRM request URL and made submission failures show whether the server or connection failed.
impact: Helps quote requests reach the CRM and gives the team a clearer starting point when a customer reports an error.

title: Improve quote submissions in Instagram browser
summary: Changed the shared quote form and Marketplace form to send JSON as a simple cross-origin request, avoiding the browser preflight step. The production CRM endpoint was verified to parse this format.
impact: Reduces submission failures for visitors opening the site inside Instagram and other in-app browsers.
